headline: His communication, attention to detail, and speed have been outstanding.
quote: Ben joined my team to support product and solution go-to-markets. He quickly became an essential member of our small but mighty product marketing team. He's tackled everything from data sheets and case studies to website content and emails—basically, anything we've thrown at him. He's an expert at managing input from multiple stakeholders, from subject-matter experts to senior executives. Through it all, his communication, attention to detail, and speed have been outstanding.
name: Viv Luu
role: Director of Product Marketing, Uber Freight
